dataset_scope: Only locally available accepted Direct episodes with full native action ACK and checker timelines and a success/horizon terminal result. Original visual observations are included wherever retained.
primary_SR: successes / complete_native_episodes; this is the published complete-trajectory subset, not a redefinition of the original campaign contract.
original_contract_SR: The original target campaign accepted 56 policy outcomes including two PolicyStop failures. Its 10/56 is retained as a scope note, not replaced by the 10/54 complete-native subset.
deduplication: Mirror copies and successive accepted snapshots do not create new evaluation episodes.
not_redistributed: Other-host historical summaries; literature results; engineering/interrupted/infrastructure attempts; PolicyStop trajectories; raw transport streams, databases, credentials, deployment configuration, weights and simulator assets.
